### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode
- Opening: "Hi, I'd like to upgrade my Wayfare Pass to Plus Monthly today, please." Target object = his own Wayfare Pass membership; timing = today; action boundary = plan change to Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly; authorisation: "you want the plan change itself and any payment to be done by you, from your own app … you do not want anyone charging you without you pressing the button" → every money-collecting write is a user-owned tool executed on hand-over.
- Identification: phone 7205550133; DOB 1993-11-02 only when asked; card last4 4127 as an extra.
- Passive branch: "Only if the agent tells you that something on the membership has to be paid or brought up to date before the plan can change do you react … when the agent hands you that payment step you complete it yourself". The simulator never volunteers the past-due state; the agent must surface it.

### 2. Act / wait / refuse at the frozen moment
- Records: `find_customers` → customer 65b6788c…; `find_pass_memberships` → 6a135b56-d998-4129-ab8c-18f50a8bf4ce, `Wayfare Pass Monthly`, `status: past_due`, `enrolled_date 2025-03-09`, `current_period_start 2026-10-08`, `current_period_end 2026-11-07`, auto_renew True.
- Ledger for the period starting 2026-10-08: `pass_payment_decline` 2026-10-08 retry 0 and `pass_payment_decline` 2026-10-10 retry 1; no `pass_fee_charge` for 2026-10-08.
- Visible grounds: plan_change_rules ("A plan change … is allowed only on an active Wayfare Pass … membership"; table "Membership not active (for example past due …) | No plan change"); Plus Monthly tool card: "The Plus Monthly upgrade charge is worked out only after the billing period in force carries a collected membership fee." → the upgrade cannot be done as the first act. Restoration is open now: declined_payment_retry_schedule gives Monthly 7 days grace after first decline (2026-10-08 → still inside on 10-11); declined fees doc term 3: "If the fee is collected (a retry, or a payment method the member adds) before the plan's grace period … the membership becomes active again with the same period dates".
- Answer: act now — first restore (member pays), then upgrade (member). Not a refusal, not a wait. Move-up path: plan_change_paths "Wayfare Pass Monthly | May move up to mid-period: … Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly"; no plan-change charge in the current period (limit 1).

### 3. Narrowest object, keys, rows in/out
- Membership 6a135b56…; period in force 2026-10-08..2026-11-07 (31 days).
- Declined attempts on this period's renewal: 2 (10-08 scheduled, 10-10 retry 1). The 2026-05-08 scheduled decline belongs to the May period (that period was later paid on 2026-05-10) — it is an "other declined scheduled renewal" for the loyalty restoration factor, not an attempt on this renewal.
- Trips/charges: all 17 customer trips read; trips 2026-09-22 (Black) and 2026-10-09 (Standard, taken while past due) carry no membership id and no credit entry.
- Windows anchored on 2026-10-11: last three months = from 2026-07-11; last six months = from 2026-04-11.

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Restoration payment** (restore_past_due_pass_5ad4a609 `amount`)
- Baseline (restoration_payment_amount): "the plan's membership fee for the billing period in force" = 9.99 (plan_fees_and_billing_periods: Monthly 9.99).
- Restored-period share (restored_period_share_of_fee): monthly plan, declined attempts 2 < retries+1 = 4 → days 2026-10-11..2026-11-07 = 28 over 31 → 9.99×28/31 = 9.0232258 (exact fraction, not rounded).
- Payment recovery fee (payment_recovery_fee): "exactly 2 | 0.50" → +0.50.
- Loyalty restoration discount: whole months 2025-03-09 → 2026-10-11 = 19; other declined scheduled renewals in the 12 months before = 1 (2026-05-08) → "18 or more | exactly one | 5 percent".
- Frequent-rider restoration discount: fare charges dated ≥ 2026-07-11: 07-18, 07-30, 08-02, 08-15, 08-27, 09-03, 09-22, 09-29, 10-09 = 9 → "6 to 11 | 2 percent" (7 if the two non-member-linked trips were dropped — same tier).
- Credit-use restoration discount: credit spent entries dated ≥ 2026-04-11: 06-05 3.10, 07-30 1.60, 08-27 1.40 = 6.10 (04-05 2.50 is outside) → "4.00 or more, under 8.00 | 1 percent".
- Discount base: "that percentage of the membership fee the payment collects for the period in force" = the share-adjusted 9.0232258 (credit-use worked figure: "a payment that collects a fee amount of 64.00" on a 96.00 plan, the 8/12 share of the restored-period worked case 2).
- Payment = 9.0232258 + 0.50 − 8% × 9.0232258 = 8.8013677 → **8.80**.
- Closest alternative: discounts taken on the plan fee 9.99 → 8.72; excluded by the wording "the membership fee the payment collects" and the 64.00 worked figure, but this is the most fragile reading in the task.
- Fall-back (computation document alone): **9.99** — definite and different.

**(b) Plus Monthly upgrade charge** (upgrade_pass_to_plus_monthly_9f7c0895 `proration_charge`), after the restoration charge of 8.80 dated 2026-10-11 is on the ledger.
- Baseline (plus_monthly_upgrade_charge_calculation): 19.99 less unused-period credit; fees collected for the period 8.80, no refunds.
- Unused-period share (plus_monthly_unused_period_share): latest membership fee charge 2026-10-11, 0 days old ≤ 2-day window; no credit earn entry for period 2026-10-08 → "the whole period" → credit 8.80.
- Comfort-rider upgrade discount: completed Comfort/Black drop-offs ≥ 07-11: Comfort 08-15, Black 09-22 = 2 → 2% of 19.99 = 0.3998.
- Airport-rider upgrade discount: completed airport trips ≥ 07-11: 08-02 pickup DEN, 09-29 drop-off DEN = 2 → 1% = 0.1999.
- Loyalty upgrade discount: 19 whole months, 9 fare-charged trips → "12 to 23 | 6 or more | 5 percent" = 0.9995.
- Priority Pickup upgrade credit: `trip_priority_pickup_charge` 07-18 and 09-29 = 2 → 1.00.
- Reserve-rider upgrade credit: `trip_reservation_fee` 2026-09-02 = 1 → 1.00.
- Charge = 19.99 − 8.80 − 0.3998 − 0.1999 − 0.9995 − 1.00 − 1.00 = 7.5908 → **7.59** (8.72 restoration path would give 7.67).
- Fall-back (computation document alone, after restoration): 19.99 − 8.80×28/31 (7.95) = **12.04**.

Factor findability (words of the records → document): `status: past_due`, `pass_payment_decline` rows → "declined attempts … scheduled attempt and each retry" (payment recovery fee, restored-period share, loyalty restoration "declined scheduled renewal"); `enrolled_date` → "whole months held"; `trip_fare_charge` rows → "trips charged a fare" (frequent-rider, loyalty); `pass_credit_redeem` → "credit spent entries"; trip `variant_name` Wayfare Comfort/Black, `airport_leg`, `trip_priority_pickup_charge`, `trip_reservation_fee` → Comfort-rider, airport-rider, Priority Pickup, Reserve-rider docs; latest `pass_fee_charge` date + absence of `pass_credit_earn` for the period → unused-period share. None of the factor docs was reachable only through the computation document's wording; the computation documents do not hint that a variation exists.

### 5. Tool sequence, owners, terminal state
1. find_customers(phone) → find_pass_memberships → find_pass_events → find_trips / find_trip_charges (agent, read). Identity: DOB asked; `verify_customer_identity` exists as a share write tool but no pass doc states an identity rule (system background not visible to this auditor).
2. Agent `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` restore_past_due_pass_5ad4a609; user `call_user_discoverable_tool` with pass_membership_id 6a135b56-d998-4129-ab8c-18f50a8bf4ce, amount 8.80 → renewal charge for 2026-10-08 period, status active.
3. Agent `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` upgrade_pass_to_plus_monthly_9f7c0895; user calls with pass_membership_id 6a135b56…, proration_charge 7.59 → plan Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, period 2026-10-11..2026-11-10.
- Terminal: membership active on Plus Monthly; ledger carries the 8.80 renewal charge and the 7.59 plan_change_proration charge. No agent-owned write.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials
- Problems: P1 restore the past-due membership (member pays the period's renewal); P0 (root) move up to Plus Monthly. Edge P0 → waits on P1. Order: P1, then P0.
- Hop P0→P1 — **state-derived**. Sentence (Plus Monthly tool card): "The Plus Monthly upgrade charge is worked out only after the billing period in force carries a collected membership fee." Records: membership `current_period_start 2026-10-08`, ledger has two `pass_payment_decline` rows for 2026-10-08 and no `pass_fee_charge` → state does not hold. Search with the state words ("past due", "membership fee collected", "billing period in force") → past_due_membership_restoration: before/after table "No membership fee collected for the period in force" → "A renewal fee charge for the period in force, in the amount of the restoration payment"; "A past-due membership is restored when the member pays the declined renewal of the billing period in force". Independently corroborated by base plan_change_rules term 1 (active only). No document names the restoration tool, route or order in the Plus Monthly documents.
- P1 has no visible prerequisite sentence of its own; nothing further.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the one thing asked" (hand over the Plus Monthly upgrade now): excluded — plan change "allowed only on an active … membership" and the upgrade charge "is worked out only after the billing period in force carries a collected membership fee"; the period has none.
- Closest alternative actions: agent-side retry/charge — no visible tool; restore with full 9.99 (excluded: restored-period share "fewer than … retries plus one" with 2 attempts); upgrade charge with days-based share 28/31 (excluded: latest charge 0 days old and no credit earned for the period → whole period); downgrade semantics N/A.
- Alternative discount base 9.99 for restoration discounts → 8.72 / 7.67; excluded by "the membership fee the payment collects" and the 64.00 worked figure — recorded as the one fragile point.
